tasks.behavior: The owner can email an invoice to the client's billing email with Send to client, and the invoice page lists each send (PLAN 10.5)
acceptance: POST /v1/profiles/{id}/invoices/{invoiceId}/send queues one outbox email to the invoice's client email when the payer can still pay it (open or partly paid, checkout not closed). A retry with the same Idempotency-Key queues no second one. No client email is 409 client_email_required; a closed invoice is 409 invoice_closed; another user is 403. One send per invoice per 24 h and 20 per profile per day, then 429 rate_limited; sends also count toward the limit for everyone together (R-82).

The worker sends it to the client whatever the owner's email setting: issuer, invoice number, amount, token and due date, with links to the pay page and the invoice PDF, and Reply-To set to the issuer's billing contact email. Tests use the fake sender; no address is logged.

The owner's invoice page has Send to client under Billed to; without a client email it says why instead of sending. Billed to lists each send with the address and the time the worker sent it, or Sending before then. axe 0 and no sideways scroll at 390 px.
openapi.yaml and docs/backend/api.md describe the endpoint, its errors and limits, and the new email.

2026-10-17 review fail by reviewer: Blocking: apps/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1519-1521. The Error schema's code enum lacks the two new codes, client_email_required and invoice_closed (httpio/errors.go:51,53). Every other code in errors.go is in that enum, and api.md Errors says codes are listed in the spec. So the 409 bodies of the new endpoint break the documented contract (acceptance 4). Add both codes to the enum. Everything else checks out: idempotent replay and cross-invoice conflict, the open status rule, the 24 h and 20/day limits with Retry-After, the profile row lock, the shared bucket taken only after the rules pass, migration Up/Down (matches 00028; the down test passes), recipient and Reply-To, no address logged, bell and public GET leave sends out. Non-blocking notes: (1) send-to-client.tsx:57 with invoices-copy.ts:393 shows 'today's limit, try again tomorrow' for every 429, also for the shared bucket that refills in seconds. (2) notify.go:167 uses options > 1 only, so a payer-chooses invoice already locked to one option is emailed as USD with 'You choose on the payment page'; a partly paid one shows the full amount. (3) After a send the button unmounts and focus drops to the body; cancel moves focus on purpose. (4) A send the worker gave up on still blocks the next send for 24 h. (5) The invoice status is read without a lock and the worker does not check it again, so an invoice paid or canceled seconds later is still emailed. (6) docs/backend/architecture.md:169-173 makes an already long sentence longer (D-84); a separate sentence for invoice.sent fixes it. (7) send.go:15 says the limits keep the Resend budget for paid emails, but 5 profiles at 20 a day use the whole 100/day free tier. (8) The 19:31Z task note about e2e 422 is stale; verify at 19:40Z passed e2e. Checks run: backend test, web test (88), lint, typecheck --force and check-docs all pass; no anvil left.
